ownership.title: Strategy and ICP
ownership.body: We own the outbound strategy and the ICP. The agreed ICP defines who enters the campaign and who can count toward a qualified meeting. You own the sales conversation.

ownership.title: Data and infrastructure
ownership.body: We own prospect data and sending infrastructure: dedicated domains, mailboxes, data, and sending tools. Outreach runs on those domains, not your main domain.

ownership.title: Copy and outreach
ownership.body: We write the copy and run email and LinkedIn outreach. Strategy, data, reply handling, and booking stay with us. You take the sales calls.

ownership.title: Replies and booking
ownership.body: We answer replies within five minutes and book the meeting. A positive reply is not enough. The meeting must be with a decision-maker inside the agreed ICP who has agreed to hear the offer.

pricing_intro: Pay $100 per qualified booked appointment, plus $1,500 per month for infrastructure covering domains, mailboxes, data, and sending tools. The agreement rolls monthly, with no long contract.

faqs.q: What does a cold email agency do?
faqs.a: A cold email agency runs outbound email to reach prospective buyers and book sales conversations. The Revenue Inbox owns strategy, ICP, data, copy, sending infrastructure, email and LinkedIn outreach, reply handling, and meeting booking. You take the sales calls and close the deals.

faqs.q: What makes The Revenue Inbox different?
faqs.a: We have booked 1,000+ meetings from cold email in the last two years. Replies are handled within five minutes. Pricing is $100 per qualified booked appointment plus monthly infrastructure. The promise is 20 qualified meetings in 30 days from campaign launch, or we work for free.

faqs.q: Will you send cold email from our main domain?
faqs.a: No. We use dedicated sending domains and mailboxes, not your main domain. Those domains and mailboxes are part of the sending infrastructure we own for the campaign. The $1,500 monthly infrastructure fee covers domains, mailboxes, data, and sending tools.

faqs.q: What counts as a qualified meeting?
faqs.a: A qualified meeting is with a decision-maker inside the agreed ICP who has agreed to hear the offer. A positive reply alone is not a qualified meeting. That distinction matters: the appointment fee is for a qualified booked appointment, not simply for someone responding to outreach.

faqs.q: How much does the service cost, and how long is the contract?
faqs.a: The service costs $100 per qualified booked appointment plus $1,500 per month for infrastructure. Infrastructure includes domains, mailboxes, data, and sending tools. The agreement is rolling monthly, with no long contract.

The promise is 20 qualified meetings in 30 days from campaign launch, or we work for free. The clock starts at campaign launch. A qualified meeting requires a decision-maker inside the agreed ICP who has agreed to hear the offer. Positive replies alone do not count toward the promise.

faqs.q: Can cold email work in a small market?
faqs.a: A small market needs a closer look, not a blanket yes. Parking Compliance Systems reaches parking lot owners with a list built from physical locations, and that campaign produces 26 qualified leads a day. Small markets need careful targeting and follow-up, not the same list everyone else buys.
